## Summary

**MOVIW** (Move Immediate Word extended to Long): Move data to destination.

The original shows the title of one of these pages grayed out; see the variants below.

## Details

### Variant 1: Move Immediate Word extended to Long

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `data → <ea>` |
| Syntax | `MOVIW.L #<data>,<ea>` |
| Short | Move data to destination. |
| Description | Sign extend immediate word data to long and move to destination. |
| Condition codes | see table |

#### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | 0 | 0 |

#### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `0011` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Register |
| 1 | 8–6 | Mode |
| 1 | 5–0 | `111101` |
| 2 | 15–0 | 16-bit word data |

#### Example

```asm
    moviw.l    #$8123,d0
```

```text
Result:
ea d0: .. .. .. .. FF FF 81 23
```

### Variant 2: Move Immediate Word extended to Long (LineA encoding)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `data → <ea>` (LineA instruction) |
| Syntax | `MOVIW.L #<data>,<ea>` |
| Short | Move data to destination. |
| Description | Sign extend immediate word data to long and move to destination. |
| Condition codes | see table |

#### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | 0 | 0 |

#### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–6 | `1010001000` |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–0 | 16-bit word data |

#### Example

```asm
    moviw.l    #$8123,d0
```

```text
Result:
ea d0: .. .. .. .. FF FF 81 23
```

#### Notes

- This is a LineA instruction, set apollo-bit in SR to become active. (ori #$800,sr)
- Do not use, only available on cores 10280 to 10904

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no MOVIW. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use the LineA encoding of MOVIW.L: the manual says it is only available on cores 10280 to 10904. The other encoding has no such note.
